title: Keyword Map
description: Output contract of KEYWORD-STRATEGY.md (module 02, PLAN phase). The article's keyword tiers, entities, and metrics. METRICS POLICY (Data Availability Policy): every field in metrics MUST be either a number actually received from a real integration (with its source recorded in metrics_sources) or the exact string "UNAVAILABLE". NEVER estimate, round-guess, or typical-value search volume, keyword difficulty, CPC, competition, rankings, or traffic estimates; a fabricated number is worse than none. A keyword map with all metrics UNAVAILABLE is complete and useful: the tiers optimize topical relevance and intent match, which require no volume data.

primary_keyword.description: Exactly one: the article's main query, taken verbatim from the intent analysis.

role.description: Why this keyword is in the set: a close variant of the primary, an angle on one of the intent's subtopics, or another supporting angle of the same intent.

secondary_keywords.description: Two to five supporting angles of the same intent, never a different intent.

long_tail_keywords.description: Longer, narrower phrasings of the same intent; typically map to individual sections or FAQ answers rather than the H1.

semantic_keywords.description: Terms that co-occur naturally with the topic; coverage material, not insertion targets.

question_queries.description: Natural-language questions users ask around the main question; flow into the brief's user_questions.

related_queries.description: Adjacent queries. Derived from real SERP data when available; otherwise reasoned, with derivation_basis stating so.

entities.description: Named things search engines recognize for the topic, e.g. basil, Ocimum basilicum, refrigeration.

supporting_topics.description: Page-level topics the article touches but does not own; internal-link candidates backed only by real CMS inventory pages.

metrics.description: Every field is either a real number from a real integration (source recorded in metrics_sources) or the exact string UNAVAILABLE. Inventing any of these values violates the Data Availability Policy and poisons downstream decisions.

search_volume.description: Search volume. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

keyword_difficulty.description: Keyword difficulty. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

cpc.description: Cost per click. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

competition.description: Competition level. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

ranking.description: Current ranking position for the primary keyword. Number only when received from a real integration (e.g. Search Console); otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

traffic_estimate.description: Estimated traffic. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

metrics_sources.description: Map of metric name to the real source that supplied it (integration or export name). A numeric metric without a recorded source is a policy violation; omit this object when every metric is UNAVAILABLE.

derivation_basis.description: What primarily fed the tiers: real SERP data, CMS inventory, or intent reasoning.
